welcomeBody: Pick a route. Collect a stamp at each stop.
nicknameHint: Saved only on this device. You can change it later.
printAlt: Woodblock print of the Kamo River at Shijō
printCredit: Cover print by Utagawa Hiroshige II · The Met (CC0)
mapLoadError: The Kyoto map could not load. You can still browse the stored walks.
mapSearchPlaceholder: Where to? e.g. Yasaka, river, 10 min
locationStatusOff: No location selected. Choose GPS or Demo Mode.
locationStatusRequesting: Waiting for browser location permission and a fix…
locationStatusLowAccuracy: Live GPS is imprecise (±{accuracy} m). Your position may be off.
locationStatusLowAccuracyOutside: Live GPS is imprecise (±{accuracy} m) and reports a position outside Kyoto.
locationStatusOutsideKyoto: Outside Kyoto. Your actual location is shown (±{accuracy} m).
locationStatusDenied: Location permission denied. Retry or use Demo Mode.
locationStatusTimeout: Location timed out. Retry or use Demo Mode.
locationStatusUnavailable: Location unavailable. Check browser support and HTTPS.
locationStatusPaused: GPS stopped outside Explore. Tap Use My Location to resume.
routesMapChecked: These walks follow map-checked pedestrian ways. Check current signs and conditions before walking.
routesSearchFallback: No exact match for that search — here are our curated Kyoto walks.
routesEmpty: No walk matches this search or theme yet.
routesCommunityNotConsulted: Community representatives have not reviewed this place entry. Respect current signs and local access rules.
gameStopHint: Keep the stamps and points already earned and end this walk?
gameGpsHint: Check-in opens within {radius} m, with a fresh GPS fix accurate to ±{accuracy} m.
receiptStandard: Why: base {base} pts at the standard rate
missionsEmptyAvailable: Every walk is in progress or complete.
missionsEmptyActive: No walk in progress. Start one from Available.
missionsEmptyCompleted: Finish a walk to see it here.
goshuinBody: One seal per stop, kept on this device.
rewardsDisclosure: Demo vouchers from fictional shops. Points have no cash value, and no real store accepts these vouchers.
rewardsEmptyMine: Unlock a voucher with your points to see it here.
rewardsNoActivity: Check in on a walk to start earning points.
locationSettingsHint: Turning Demo Mode off keeps GPS off. Recenter opens Explore; paused live GPS needs a new Use My Location tap.
mapLookHint: Stored on this device only. Seasonal colours follow the Kyoto calendar month.
gameResetBody: Clear all walks, stamps, points and vouchers on this browser? Your nickname and language will be kept.
aboutBody: Explore curated Kyoto walking routes, collect goshuin-style stop stamps, and unlock neighborhood rewards.
bonusBusScenario: Buses along Shijō-dōri are busy right now — walk to earn 2× points.
bonusQuietScenario: Visit Yasaka Shrine and Maruyama Park during quieter hours for 2× points.
missionsBonusBody: Earn 2× points on bus-relief walks or quiet-hour visits when an active bonus is on.
missionsBonusNone: No bonus is active right now. Check-ins earn the standard rate.
missionsVerifyNote: Check in near each stop to collect your stamp and points.
scenarioHint: Switch an active bonus scenario for your walk.
rewardPillLabel: Rewards: {points} of {target} points toward the next voucher
celebrateSeals: {count} seals added to your stamp book.
helpIntro: Walk curated Kyoto routes, collect stop stamps, and earn points for local rewards.
helpCheckinsBody: Arrive near each stop along your walk to stamp your goshuin book and earn points.
helpHaloBody: The translucent circle around the fox shows your nearby check-in zone as you walk.
helpScenariosBody: Bus-relief and quiet-hour bonuses award 2× points on featured walks during busy periods.
helpVouchersBody: Collect points from stop check-ins and walk completions to unlock rewards in the Rewards tab.
helpCrowdBody: Crowd badges give a quick snapshot of how busy key corridors are along each route.
rotateBody: Kyoto Walk works in portrait. Rotate your phone to keep exploring.
storyLocked: Check in here to unlock this place's story.
trailBody: Collect {goal} different seals on any walks.
trailDone: Trail complete! Every seal is in your stamp book.
chipBikeNote: Cycling routes haven't been checked for safety or legality yet, so Kyoto Flow doesn't suggest any.
chipLuggageNote: No walk has been surveyed for steps, kerbs or surfaces yet, so none is marked luggage-friendly. Check each walk's accessibility notes.
locationStatusOffPublic: No location selected. Tap Use My Location to see nearby walks, or browse the list.
locationStatusDeniedPublic: Location permission denied. You can still browse every walk and its stops.
locationStatusTimeoutPublic: Location timed out. Try again, or browse the walks without GPS.
missionsBonusBodyPublic: Earn 2× points on bus-relief walks or quiet-hour visits when an active bonus is on.
homeQuickWalk: Start a new walk on Explore
trackStopsToUnlock: {stops} more check-ins on this walk to unlock: {offer}
trackOneStopToUnlock: 1 more check-in on this walk to unlock: {offer}
trackShortAfterWalk: {points} more pts still needed after this walk for: {offer}
startPointPickerHint: Browse from a landmark without turning on GPS.
savedEmpty: Tap Save on any walk or place to keep it here.
missionEligibility: Check in at all {total} stops to complete
voucherExpiredNote: This offer has passed its Kyoto-time expiry and cannot be unlocked or redeemed.
redeemOfflineNote: Offline: merchant redemption requires an online connection.
offlineBanner: Offline mode · viewing cached itinerary & voucher terms
privacyBody: Location is only read in the foreground while Explore is open and is never sent to a server or stored as history. Profile, progress, and saved items stay on this browser.
deleteAllDataBody: Delete your nickname, language, walks, stamps, points, vouchers, saved items, and cached offline files from this browser?
safetyBody: Official external disaster guidance for Kyoto. Nearest-shelter status is not shown because this prototype has no live shelter feed.
reportIssueBody: Share a path blockage, step barrier, or signage issue so the route can be reviewed.
reportIssueNotesPlaceholder: Describe the spot or sign you saw…
musicHint: Loops softly while you explore Kyoto. Pauses automatically when you leave the app.
foxGuideSubtitle: Ask about nearby stops, local etiquette, or walks.
foxGuidePlaceholder: Ask about this spot or Kyoto…
landmarkAskFoxPrompt: Tell me about {name} in Kyoto and any etiquette tips.
landmarkOrientationNote: Orientation landmark on the map — not a stamp check-in stop.
